basedOnGuidedDemoEvidenceDemoDiagnosesCo: Based on guided demo evidence. Demo diagnoses cover limited examples.
exampleRevealedThisAttemptWillBeRecorded: Example revealed. This attempt will be recorded as supported practice.
chooseYourOwnNextStepAfterCheckingPracti: Choose your own next step after checking. Practised means you completed an attempt; it does not update mastery or erase the original issue. You can practise before the suggested date.
showingTheLatest10AttemptsTheseAnswersAr: Showing the latest 10 attempts. These answers are separate from the original lesson evidence.
shortFollowUpPracticeBasedOnYourSavedLes: Short follow-up practice based on your saved lesson evidence.
noReviewTasksInThisViewCompleteALessonTo: No review tasks in this view. Complete a lesson to generate follow-up practice, or open an older report and choose “Generate targeted review”.
practiceSavedChooseAnotherPendingTaskWhe: Practice saved. Choose another pending task when you are ready.

feedback.reference_match: Matches the reference wording. This is a recall check, not a grammar assessment.
feedback.reference_differs: Your wording differs from the reference. Another answer may be valid; compare the suggestion and original context.
feedback.target_observed: Target expression observed. Check the meaning and sentence yourself; this is not a correctness assessment.
feedback.target_missing: The target expression was not found. Try the target term or an accepted course form, then check again.
feedback.self_check: Compare your reply with the course facts, goals and example, then record your own judgment.
